doubts: A page of three walks. Black Hill Walk: DOC calls it '1 hr 30 min return' but the text describes descending to the highway and following it back to Lodge Road, so recorded as a loop; its start 'end of Lodge Road' could be either of two features where Black Hill Track meets Lodge Road (F2, F4), so null. Moraine Walk start F1 is where Moraine Walk meets the highway, taken as the SH 63 / Lodge Road junction; its end at the Buller River has no entry, and 'return' is read as out and back. Anglers Walk on its own has only a start (Buller Bridge on Mt Robert Road, no matching feature; F7 is on the highway) and no stated end, so it is recorded only within the Moraine/Anglers circuit (W3), whose exact joining points and order are not stated.
